subject: Mosaic initiative: activation plan for 3 new project keys & contract amendment
messages:
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@brightwave.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samuel Hunt <samuel.hunt@brightwave.ai>, procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mosaic expansion & renewal timing

Hi Hannah,

We're preparing to take Mosaic (our internal customer-facing suite) into three additional business units next quarter and I'd like to align on onboarding, API key provisioning, and how that affects our upcoming renewal. The teams are: RetailOps, CarePortal, and AnalyticsLab. Rough asks:

- 3 separate project keys (one per team) with separate rate quotas and billing tags
- a staged rollout over 4-6 weeks starting Feb 6
- temporary burst capacity for the first two weeks of activation for onboarding tests
- a short contract amendment to reflect the additional committed capacity and updated invoicing cadence

I'm attaching our draft SOW and procurement form for context.

Attachments: BrightWave_SOW_Draft.pdf, procurement_form_draft.pdf

Can we set a 30–45 minute call tomorrow to walk through options? Procurement also needs the billing contact and an estimate they can use for internal approvals.

Thanks,
Maria Ortega
CFO, BrightWave
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic expansion & renewal timing

Hi Maria — thanks for the context and the SOW. Happy to run through this. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

- Provisioning: we can issue 3 dedicated project API keys with separate tags and quota windows. Keys can be mapped to team-level billing tags for traceability.
- Staged rollout: suggest Phase 0 (preprod verification, 1 week), Phase 1 (RetailOps), Phase 2 (CarePortal), Phase 3 (AnalyticsLab) — target total 5–6 weeks.
- Burst capacity: we can enable burst overrides for the first 14 days on a temporary reserved pool (extra cost but controlled).
- Contract: we'll draft a short amendment that increases committed throughput for the renewal period and adds a one-time provisioning fee. Marissa will lead on the amendment language and pricing.

Proposed call: Wed 10:30–11:00 PT or Thu 09:00–09:30 PT. Which works for your team?

I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) for the rollout and a link to the MAP in the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.pdf
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7721

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>, Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic expansion & renewal timing (technical scoping)

Hi all — looping in some technical detail to help with procurement and SRE planning. Key points: 

- Each project key will be logically isolated: separate project IDs, separate usage metrics, and independent rate limits. That avoids cross-team quota collisions.
- We recommend per-key token caches for each team's long-running sessions to keep latency predictable.
- For the burst window, we'll allocate a temporary 2x capacity pool for 14 days and then scale back automatically. We'll need a signed amendment to activate burst billing.

Attached is our key provisioning playbook and a sample tag mapping for your CI/CD teams to use.

Attachments: key_provisioning_playbook.pdf

If you want, we can run a tech-runbook session with your DevOps on Friday (30–45 minutes).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@brightwave.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samuel Hunt <samuel.hunt@brightwave.ai>, procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic expansion & renewal timing

Thanks Hannah and Ben — that looks good. A few clarifying items from procurement and SRE: 

- Procurement: please include a consolidated estimated cost for the 6-week rollout including the one-time provisioning fee + the 14-day burst capacity. We need that figure for internal approvals.
- SRE (Samuel): prefers keys to be issued on Mon Feb 5 so they can run preprod tests the week of Feb 5.
- Contract: we prefer a simple 12-month amendment (aligned to our renewal cycle) rather than extending the whole agreement.

I've attached the completed procurement form for your billing team.

Attachments: procurement_form_filled.pdf

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll target the Thu call if that time still works.

Best,
Maria Ortega
CFO, BrightWave
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@brightwave.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic expansion & renewal timing — proposal and amendment draft

Hi Maria — following up from our call this morning. Attached is a concise amendment (v2) and a cost summary for the staged rollout: 

Summary highlights:
- 3 project keys provisioned and tagged by team
- One-time provisioning fee: $2,500
- Temporary burst pool for 14 days: estimated $1,800 (capped)
- Incremental monthly committed throughput adjustment: +150M tokens at a discounted rate for the 12-month amendment period
- Target key issuance date: Mon Feb 5; rollouts phased over 5 weeks (Phases 0–3)

Next steps:
1) Please confirm approval of the amendment language and costs
2) Procurement to confirm PO and billing contact (we'll provide invoice after signature)
3) We will create the three project keys and schedule the tech-runbook session for Feb 6

Attachments: amendment_redwood_brightwave_v2.docx
Links: https://redwood-internal.drive/mosaic-playbook

If that's aligned I'll create a DocuSign packet and route it to the procurement contact.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@brightwave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samuel Hunt <samuel.hunt@brightwave.ai>, procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic expansion & renewal timing — proposal and amendment draft

Marissa/Hannah — this looks good to us. We approve the amendment language and the cost summary. Please send the DocuSign and a pro forma invoice to procurement@brightwave.ai so our finance team can issue the PO.

Quick ask: can we kick off the tech-runbook on Mon Feb 5 at 10:00 AM PT? Samuel will host.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — Maria
